title: The Seed That Dreamed of Sun
description: A tiny seed buried in darkness learns patience and courage.
activities: Draw a picture of a seed growing into a plant. What does it need to grow?
Find 3 things outside that were once seeds. What are they now?
Write or tell a story about something small that became something big.

title: The River That Sang
description: A river learns that its voice can heal a thirsty village.
activities: Listen to water sounds (rain, tap, stream). What emotions do they bring?
Make your own water music using bottles with different water levels.
Write a thank-you note to a river or body of water near you.

title: Rumi and the Mango Tree
description: Rumi discovers that the oldest mango tree in the village holds a secret about belonging.
activities: Find a tree you like. Sit with it for 5 minutes and write what you notice.
Ask an elder in your family about a tree they remember from childhood.
Draw your family tree — include the non-human members too (pets, trees, places).
